description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Wind, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] after using a Wind/Water ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Costume Element Mode
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Water] to the user after using four Wind or Water abilities if the triggering ability deals Wind/Water damage, removed after triggering
